answers.rationale: Protein and RNA up, replicated in TCGA. Macrophages hold a larger transcript share (0.6) than RCC (0.2), so not tumour-intrinsic. Surface unknown, IHC not measured, DepMap not selective.

Protein down. CPTAC RNA down but TCGA RNA significantly up, so not replicated. RCC has the largest share but the purity interval includes 0. Vital protein enriched in liver. No surface record. No DepMap dependency.

Protein up, replicated in TCGA RNA and confirmatory protein. RCC has the largest transcript share and the purity interval is above 0. Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level is 1 with no proteome enrichment. DepMap not selective, which doesn't affect the verdict.
